XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic failure to engage odd gears, with engine fault warning light coming on.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with a 7-speed DSG7 S-Tronic gearbox (Volkswagen 0GC dual-clutch gearbox)

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Automatic gearbox mechatronic control unit

  • Fault: The engine experiences difficulty engaging odd gears, with the engine fault warning light coming on; when setting off from second gear, the gearbox jumps directly to fourth.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P1735 (Clutch Position Sensor A – Fault)
    • P0562 (Fuel/Battery System – Low Voltage)
  • Cause: Faulty automatic gearbox mechatronic control unit

• Intervention: Check the operation of the automatic transmission mechatronic control unit and, if necessary, proceed with its repair.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The mechatronic control unit of the gearbox did not show any visual abnormalities and is accessible from the lower part of the engine compartment, on the driver's side between the engine and the radiator, inside the gearbox itself.
